text: Flexdeal, SIMFE, S.A. held 49.21% of the share capital and voting rights of Raize - Instituição de Pagamentos, and in January 2026 informed the Bank of Portugal of its intention to raise that stake to up to 51%.

source.name: Jornal Económico: Flexdeal quer aumentar participação na Raize para 51%
source.quote: A Flexdeal detém atualmente 49,21% do capital e dos direitos de voto da Raize
source.note: English: Flexdeal currently holds 49.21% of the capital and voting rights of Raize. The same report says Flexdeal, SIMFE informed the Bank of Portugal of its intention to raise its qualifying holding to up to 51%.

additionalSources.name: Jornal PT50: Flexdeal sobe participação na Raize para 51%
additionalSources.quote: Atualmente, a empresa conta com 2.460.523 ações, equivalentes a 49,21% do capital social.
additionalSources.note: Independent report of the same Flexdeal market notification: Flexdeal is already Raize's largest shareholder at 49.21% and has asked the Bank of Portugal to go to 51%.
